    From our kitchen

    Toppings are separate options so the base focaccia stays plain. The Sichuan pepper oil and soy caramelised onions are our go-to alternative to garlic, rosemary or chilli garlic.

    Focaccia · 28 Oct 2026

    • Ramen Egg (Ajitsuke Tamago) We use dashi powder in place of the 5 g bonito flakes, so there's nothing to strain out. It can be left out entirely: the marinade has less umami but the eggs are still good.
    • Carne Asada Tacos Written from how we make it. The marinade is loosely based on Isabel Eats with cayenne and MSG added. The spice amounts, marinating time and quantities here are a starting point, not measured from our kitchen yet: adjust them after the next cook.
